pr_01.m_zh: 温暖、讲故事的开头；「就爱玩」前停一下，带点笑
pr_01.d_zh: 画面：早晨的阳光里，你指着图画书上的农舍和田地，给身边的孩子介绍这一家人。说到弟弟时，你忍不住偷偷笑了一下。
pr_01.m_en: warm storyteller opening; small smile and a pause before 'just liked to play'
pr_01.d_en: Picture: soft morning light. You point at a farmhouse and a field in a picture book for a child next to you. When you get to the little brother, you smile a little.

pr_02.m_zh: 调皮、轻飘飘、有点被宠坏；「好好玩一玩」要亮
pr_02.d_zh: 画面：你大摇大摆走到爸爸面前，手一伸，像在要零花钱。你满脑子都是远方好玩的东西，根本没看爸爸的脸。
pr_02.m_en: cheeky, breezy, a bit spoilt; bright on 'have some fun'
pr_02.d_en: Picture: you walk up to Dad with your hand out, like asking for pocket money. You only think about the fun far away. You do not look at his face.

pr_03.m_zh: 先叹一口气；慢、舍不得；「要小心啊」前声音卡一下
pr_03.d_zh: 画面：你手里拿着钱袋，慢慢放进孩子手里，舍不得松手。你知道他要走很远，心里又疼又担心。
pr_03.m_en: a sad sigh first; loving and slow; a catch before 'be careful'
pr_03.d_en: Picture: you hold the money bag and slowly put it in your son's hand. You do not want to let go. He is going far away and you are worried.

pr_04.m_zh: 无忧无虑、像唱歌一样，边走边说
pr_04.d_zh: 画面：你背着钱袋已经走在大路上了，头也不回，只把手举起来挥一挥。
pr_04.d_en: Picture: you are already on the road with your bag. You do not turn around. You just lift one hand and wave.

pr_05.d_zh: 画面：你在田里靠着锄头，满头是汗，看着弟弟蹦蹦跳跳走远，对着自己嘀咕一句。
pr_05.d_en: Picture: you lean on your hoe in the hot field. You watch your little brother skip away, and you mutter to yourself.

pr_06.m_zh: 热闹、带一点「真不像话」的口气
pr_06.d_zh: 画面：你在跟孩子讲一个淘气朋友的事：彩灯、糖果、新衣服，钱币像水一样哗哗流走。你边讲边摇头。
pr_06.m_en: lively, a bit disapproving, like telling about a naughty friend
pr_06.d_en: Picture: you tell a child about a naughty friend. Coloured lights, sweets, new clothes, coins running away like water. You shake your head as you tell it.

pr_07.d_zh: 画面：彩灯下的小饭馆里，你站到凳子上，把钱币往天上一抛，对满屋子的人喊。
pr_07.d_en: Picture: a little inn with coloured lights. You stand on a stool, throw coins in the air, and shout to the whole room.

pr_08.m_zh: 几个人一起欢呼，咯咯笑，有点贪吃
pr_08.d_zh: 画面：桌上摆满好吃的，你们一边伸手抓，一边朝请客的人欢呼，嘴里还塞着东西。
pr_08.m_en: a few friends cheering together, giggly, a bit greedy
pr_08.d_en: Picture: the table is full of food. You grab it with both hands and cheer for the boy who pays. Your mouth is still full.

pr_09.m_zh: 先纳闷，再慢慢吓到；「一个都没有了」声音变小
pr_09.d_zh: 画面：你把手伸进钱袋，空的。再把口袋翻出来，还是空的。灯一盏一盏灭了。
pr_09.m_en: puzzled, then slowly shocked; small voice on 'none left'
pr_09.d_en: Picture: you put your hand in the bag. Empty. You turn out your pockets. Empty too. The lights go out one by one.

pr_10.m_zh: 一下子变冷淡、随随便便，声音越走越远
pr_10.d_zh: 画面：你们刚才还搂着他的肩膀，现在互相看一眼，放下杯子，一边说一边往门口溜。
pr_10.m_en: suddenly cool and off-hand, voices fading as they leave
pr_10.d_en: Picture: a minute ago your arm was on his shoulder. Now you look at each other, put down your cups, and walk to the door while you talk.

pr_11.m_zh: 放慢、严肃、压低声音，干干的
pr_11.d_zh: 画面：彩色的灯全灭了，地都干裂了，风吹起黄土，摊子上一点吃的也没有。你压低声音告诉孩子。
pr_11.d_en: Picture: the coloured lights are gone. The ground is cracked and dusty, and the market has no food. You lower your voice to tell the child.

pr_12.m_zh: 平平地说，「喂猪」时轻轻皱一下眉
pr_12.d_zh: 画面：你看见他提着一袋豆荚走进又脏又臭的猪圈，说到「喂猪」时你自己都皱了皱鼻子。
pr_12.d_en: Picture: you see him carry a sack into a muddy, smelly pig pen. When you say 'pigs', your own nose wrinkles a little.

pr_13.m_zh: 没力气、可怜兮兮；中间停一下像肚子叫；「好香」又馋又好笑
pr_13.d_zh: 画面：你站在泥里撒豆荚，猪挤来挤去抢着吃。你的肚子咕噜一声，眼睛盯着地上的豆荚咽口水。
pr_13.m_en: weak, sorry for himself; a tummy-rumble pause; funny longing on 'yummy'
pr_13.d_en: Picture: you stand in the mud and throw pods to the pigs. They push and eat. Your tummy rumbles, and you stare at the pods on the ground.

pr_14.m_zh: 很轻、忽然想明白了，快要哭
pr_14.d_zh: 画面：你一屁股坐在泥地里，抱着头，想起家里热腾腾的饭桌，连工人碗里都是满的。
pr_14.d_en: Picture: you sit down in the mud with your head in your hands. You remember the warm table at home. Even the workers have full bowls.

pr_15.m_zh: 忽然下定决心，声音里有希望
pr_15.d_zh: 画面：你猛地抬起头，眼睛亮了，从泥里站起来，朝家的方向看。
pr_15.m_en: sudden decision, hope in the voice
pr_15.d_en: Picture: you lift your head fast and your eyes light up. You stand up out of the mud and look toward home.

pr_16.m_zh: 在练习，认真、有点笨拙；句子之间换一口气
pr_16.d_zh: 画面：傍晚金色的路上，你一个人边走边练见到爸爸要说的话，手不知道放哪里好，说一句想一句。
pr_16.m_en: practising, earnest, a little clumsy; a breath between sentences
pr_16.d_en: Picture: a golden evening road. You walk alone and practise what to say to Dad. You do not know where to put your hands. You think before each sentence.

pr_17.m_zh: 对自己说，点点头，有点紧张
pr_17.d_zh: 画面：你停下脚步，对自己点点头，深吸一口气，又接着往家走。
pr_17.d_en: Picture: you stop, nod to yourself, take a big breath, and walk on toward home.

pr_18.d_zh: 画面：你看着一位老爸爸站在家门口，手搭在眉毛上往路的尽头望。昨天这样，前天也这样。
pr_18.d_en: Picture: you watch an old dad at the gate. He shades his eyes and looks down the road. He did this yesterday, and the day before.

pr_19.m_zh: 不敢相信，变成大喜；喘一口气，声音往上扬
pr_19.d_zh: 画面：路的尽头冒出一个小小的人影，走路的样子你太熟了。你揉揉眼睛，心怦怦跳，拔腿就跑。
pr_19.m_en: cannot believe it, then joy; breath catches, voice rises
pr_19.d_en: Picture: a tiny shape appears far down the road. You know that walk so well. You rub your eyes, your heart jumps, and you start to run.

pr_20.m_zh: 小声哭着说，说到一半被打断，声音飘走
pr_20.d_zh: 画面：爸爸把你紧紧抱在怀里，你的脸埋在他肩膀上，想把路上练好的话说出来，可是还没说完。
pr_20.m_en: crying softly, small; trails off because he is cut off
pr_20.d_en: Picture: Dad holds you tight and your face is on his shoulder. You try to say the words you practised, but you cannot finish.

pr_21.m_zh: 高兴地打断，边哭边笑，大声、忙忙碌碌
pr_21.d_zh: 画面：你一只手还搂着孩子，另一只手朝屋里使劲挥，叫大家都动起来，眼泪还挂在脸上。
pr_21.m_en: cutting in happily, laughing through tears, loud and busy
pr_21.d_en: Picture: one arm is still around your boy. With the other you wave at the house and call everyone to hurry. Tears are still on your face.

pr_22.m_zh: 两三个人抢着答应，声音从远处来
pr_22.d_zh: 画面：你们在屋里听见主人喊，放下手里的活，一边答应一边往外跑。
pr_22.m_en: two or three servants answer eagerly, from far off
pr_22.d_en: Picture: you are inside the house and hear the master call. You drop your work and run out as you answer.

pr_23.m_zh: 向所有人高兴地宣布；「失而又得」说得又慢又大
pr_23.d_zh: 画面：夜晚的院子里点满了灯，长桌上摆满菜。你举起杯子，对着所有客人大声宣布。
pr_23.m_en: joyful news to everyone; slow and big on 'lost... found'
pr_23.d_en: Picture: night in the yard, lamps everywhere, a long table full of food. You lift your cup and tell all the guests.

pr_24.d_zh: 画面：天黑了，你扛着锄头从田里回来，在墙外听见音乐和笑声。你拉住一个仆人问，越听眼睛瞪得越大。
pr_24.m_en: puzzled, then angry and cannot believe it
pr_24.d_en: Picture: it is dark. You come home from the field with your hoe and hear music behind the wall. You ask a servant, and your eyes get bigger and bigger.

pr_25.d_zh: 画面：你把锄头往地上一戳，背对着大门，两只手抱在胸前，脚像钉在地上一样。
pr_25.d_en: Picture: you push your hoe into the ground, turn your back to the door, and fold your arms. Your feet will not move.

pr_26.m_zh: 又委屈又生气，最后声音有点破
pr_26.d_zh: 画面：爸爸出来找你了。你憋了好多年的话一下子全倒出来，说到小山羊，鼻子一酸。
pr_26.m_en: hurt and angry; voice cracks a little at the end
pr_26.d_en: Picture: Dad comes outside to find you. Words you kept inside for years all pour out. At 'little goat' you nearly cry.

pr_27.m_zh: 非常温柔、有耐心，两个儿子都爱；慢；最后是带着盼望的问句
pr_27.d_zh: 画面：院子外的黑夜里，你向生气的大儿子伸出手，看着他的眼睛，一句一句慢慢说，等他把手放上来。
pr_27.m_en: very gentle, patient, loves both sons; slow; a hopeful question
pr_27.d_en: Picture: in the dark outside the yard, you hold out your hand to your angry older son. You look in his eyes, speak slowly, and wait for his hand.

pr_28.m_zh: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说
pr_28.d_zh: 画面：你合上图画书，转过来看着孩子的眼睛。这句话不是讲故事了，是讲给他听的。
pr_28.m_en: warm lesson, speaking right to the child
pr_28.d_en: Picture: you close the picture book and turn to look in the child's eyes. This is not the story now. It is for him.

pr_29.m_zh: 微笑着鼓励，最后几个字像一个拥抱
pr_29.d_zh: 画面：你蹲下来和孩子一样高，张开双臂，说完就要把他抱起来。
pr_29.m_en: smiling, gentle; the last words are like a hug
pr_29.d_en: Picture: you kneel down to the child's height and open your arms. When you finish, you will give a big hug.
